statements.text: The slotted text is the accessible name. For an icon-only button set the ariaLabel property in script (it has no attribute; an aria-label on the host is not forwarded), or use violet-icon-button.
ariaLabelledby, ariaDescribedby and ariaErrormessage are script-only properties. Like aria-controls, their ids are written inside the shadow root, where ids from the page do not resolve.

attributes.description: Visual emphasis variant for the button.
attributes.name: appearance

attributes.description: Optional controls reference forwarded to the inner button.
attributes.name: aria-controls

attributes.description: Optional expanded state forwarded to the inner button.
attributes.name: aria-expanded

attributes.description: Optional popup type forwarded to the inner button.
attributes.name: aria-haspopup

attributes.description: Optional pressed state ("true", "false" or "mixed") forwarded to the inner button for toggle buttons.
attributes.name: aria-pressed

attributes.description: Native button type forwarded to the internal control.
attributes.name: type

slots.description: Trailing inline content such as a status glyph.
slots.name: after

slots.description: Leading inline content such as an icon.
slots.name: before

summary: Text button for actions, with before and after slots for icons; also the trigger for menus, disclosures and toggle buttons.

usage.text: Not form-associated: type="submit" or "reset" is copied to a button inside the shadow root and does not submit or reset an enclosing form. Call form.requestSubmit() from a click listener.
aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-haspopup and aria-pressed set on the host (or the matching properties) are forwarded to the inner button. Use them for disclosure, menu and toggle buttons.
Put a leading icon in the before slot and a trailing one in the after slot; mark a violet-icon there decorative when the text already says what the button does.
The default appearance is primary, so in a row of buttons set secondary, quiet or transparent on all but the main action, and danger on a destructive one.
